days.title: Delhi-Mussoorie · Arrival in Mussoorie
days.body: Meet at the pickup point in Delhi. On your way to Mussoorie, you will be passing through Dehradun. In Dehradun, you can visit the Robber’s Cave, which is a natural river cave formation. You can also visit the Sahastradhara, which is a waterfall known to have medicinal properties. Take a relaxing bath in the waterfall, you can resume your journey to Mussoorie. After reaching Mussoorie, complete your check-in formalities and relax in your hotel room. You can spend the rest of the day exploring the streets of Mussoorie and relaxing. Stay overnight in Mussoorie.

days.title: Mussoorie · Explore Mussoorie
days.body: Have a scrumptious breakfast and set out to explore Mussoorie. You will be making your first stop at the Laal Tibba Scenic point, which is considered as the highest point of Mussoorie. Enjoy the views of the Himalayas from the observation deck. Marvel at the rocks that are shaped like the humps of Camel at the Camels Back Road. After that, plan a little picnic near Kempty falls where you can enjoy the beautiful views of the water cascading down. If you want to get a little adventurous, you can go on a trek to Gun Hill or even take a cable car ride to the top. Admire the unobstructed views of the Himalayas from Gun Hill. Spend your evening exploring the Mall road of Mussoorie from where you can buy souvenirs along with enjoying the beautiful views of the Doon valley. Head back to your hotel. Stay overnight in Mussoorie.

days.title: Mussoorie-Delhi · Departure
days.body: Begin your day with a scrumptious breakfast at the hotel Complete your check-out formalities from the hotel and proceed toward Delhi.
